My Services

Consider Griffith Handyman Services for your next project. This handyman can handle any kind of job including residential improvement jobs, outdoor & lawn services and jobs you don't have the time to complete yourself. I’ve been in the handyman biz since 2014, so you can trust the job will be done right and with care. Check out my list of services and get in touch for a free estimate.

Updating fixtures in your home?

Want new light fixtures? Need new bathroom or kitchen faucets? contact me to get an estimate to bring your home to your own personal style

Home  Repairs?

Have a broken Fence? Light Fixture that doesnt work? or need to repaint that room you dont have time for? I Can help, contact for an estimate.

Have a Design Idea?

Do you have a design idea for your home and dont know how to do it yourself? contact me and lets see what we can do. I have created new mantles and focal pieces in homes to bring a new life to your home.
